description: This file defines a Java interface 'EcuInit' in the package 'com.romraider.logger.ecu.comms.query'. It declares two methods: getEcuId() returning a String, and getEcuInitBytes() returning a byte array. The interface appears to be part of ECU communication querying functionality within the RomRaider project.

classes.name: EcuInit
classes.description: An interface defining methods for accessing ECU identification and initialization data.
